title: Flood-Vent Credit Schedule for HomeFlood Certificate Reviews
content:
**HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies — flood-vent credit on the re-rated term premium of a certificate review.**

| Certificate under review | Flood-vent credit |
|---|---|
| accepted for rating, certifies engineered flood openings, and shows an elevation difference of zero or more | 5 percent |
| accepted for rating, certifies engineered flood openings, and shows a negative elevation difference or no base flood elevation | the tier's mitigation credit percent, 10 percent |
| certifies no engineered flood openings | none |
| not accepted for rating | none |

**Acceptance for this credit.** For a certificate review, and only for it, a certificate entry is accepted for rating when its survey date falls fewer than 120 whole calendar months (10 years times 12) before the date Tidemark received it. Tidemark records an Elevation Certificate entry only for a certificate on FEMA Form 086-0-33, completed and sealed by a licensed land surveyor, engineer or architect, for a building not altered since the survey.

A count of whole calendar months runs from the earlier date to the later one; the last month is not counted when the later date's day of the month falls before the earlier date's day of the month.

**The certificate under review** is the most recently received Elevation Certificate entry on the policy, read for its survey date, the date Tidemark received it, its base flood elevation, its elevation difference and its flood openings. Where several entries share the latest receipt date, the one recorded first counts.

**Form of the credit.** The credit is a percent by which the re-rated term premium is reduced.

**How credits combine.** The credits of the re-rated term premium are added to one another, never multiplied. Their sum is capped at the tier's ceiling on combined credits, 15 percent. The factored amount is reduced once by that capped sum, before the loss-of-use charge is added.

## Points of judgement

- **A difference of exactly 0 feet** is "zero or more", so a certificate with certified openings and a 0-foot difference earns 5 percent.
- **No base flood elevation, openings certified.** The certificate earns the 10 percent tier credit, provided it is accepted.
- **Survey 120 or more whole months before receipt.** The certificate is not accepted for rating under this credit, and no flood-vent credit applies, whatever it certifies.

## Hypothetical cases

| Survey age at receipt (whole months) | Openings certified | Elevation difference | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40 | yes | +1 | 5 percent |
| 40 | yes | -1 | 10 percent |
| 40 | yes | none shown | 10 percent |
| 40 | no | +2 | none |
| 125 | yes | +2 | none |
